title: Transcendent
author: Stephen Baxter
review:
This had a lot going on but really good entry and finish to the trilogy while leaving plenty of the timeline open for future books.

This is also heavy and depressing on multiple levels but has the smallest throughline of hope.

Book 1 in this trilogy is probably my favorite but this is a solid second place.
